en.bdb: One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਲੈ ਮਜਨੂੰ ਆਸਕੀ ਚਹੁ ਚਕੀ ਜਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: lelai majanoo(n) aasakee chahu chakee jaatee|

en.bdb: The lovers Lana and Majanu are well known in all the quarters of the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬੀਜਾ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਘੜਾ ਵਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: soraTh beejaa gaaveeaai jas sughaRaa vaatee|

en.bdb: The excellent song of Sorath and Bija is sung in every direction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਸੀ ਪੁੰਨੂੰ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਹੁਇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: sasee pu(n)noo(n) dhosatee hui jaat ajaatee|

en.bdb: The love of Sassi and Punnü, though of different castes, is everywhere spoken of.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਹੀਵਾਲ ਨੋ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਨੈ ਤਰਦੀ ਰਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: meheevaal no sohanee nai taradhee raatee|

en.bdb: The fame of Sohni who used to swim the Chenab river in the hope to meet Mahival is well known.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਂਝਾ ਹੀਰ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਓਹੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਰਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: raa(n)jhaa heer vakhaaneeaai oh piram paraatee|

en.bdb: Ranjha and Hir are renowned for the love they bore each other.
But superior to all is the love the disciples bear their Guru.They sing it at the ambrosial hour of morning.
